program: Wingless raw-input to invariant representation to zero-shot multi-step reasoning chain
question: Can a completely task-untrained third raw surface family use only context-induced representations plus transition knowledge learned from two other families to execute unseen multi-step role programs?
hypothesis: Using the qualified R5 repaired three-family bridge, the learner will recover twenty-seven surface motifs and nine correct three-member alias classes. A class-transition model trained only on families 0 and 1 single-step task records will achieve at least 0.95 exact final-state accuracy on all 192 frozen family-2-only three-, five-, and seven-step programs, including conjugated right-role transformations, while exact-surface and shuffled-family2 controls remain at or below 0.25.

supersedes_invalid_before_execution.reason: contextual-alias multistep R3 preregistration and implementation landed after R1 preregistration before R1 implementation could be applied

scientific_reuse.design: byte-identical to the frozen R1 preregistration
scientific_reuse.forbidden: changes to R5 bridge, family2 zero-task-training isolation, program matrix, controls, metrics, thresholds, feed-forward execution, or evaluator boundary

portfolio_context.allocation: 75% chain / 25% substrate falsification over eight completed post-shift experiments

prior_evidence.observation: Family 2 had zero task-training records yet achieved 1.0 one-step accuracy through contextual alias classes; exact-surface scored 0.0625 and shuffled context 0.05.

authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority
validity_criteria: Exact parent, North Star, and sealed R5 evidence identity match.
R2 scientific code is byte-equivalent to the staged R1 scientific code except experiment identifiers.
Bridge construction, representation selection, normal classes, shuffled family2 assignment, and task-training corpus are byte-identical to R5.
Exactly 192 heldout programs execute and every input value and operation motif is family 2.
All learners feed their own predictions into subsequent steps.
Evaluator operation semantics and semantic mappings are inaccessible to prediction.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all twenty-five frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and induced zero-shot multi-step accuracy materially exceeds both controls, but at least one 0.95 threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but induced multi-step execution does not materially outperform exact-surface or shuffled controls.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the full 192-program matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any family2 task leakage, R5 reuse drift, feed-forward violation, evaluator-boundary violation, deterministic-state, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: No training corpus, bridge, representation, class induction, program, learner, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after primary output.
